current_repo_note: GitHub reports NOASSERTION, which is correct here: the licence is a modified Apache 2.0 rather than the standard text, so no identifier applies.
canonical_data: application definitions as versioned YAML, knowledge-base documents and embeddings, and conversation and workflow run logs
strengths: A human-input node makes approval and review a first-class workflow step, deliverable by email to people without an account
Applications export and import as versioned declarative files, so the definition itself is portable
Persistence is backend-agnostic across several relational databases and many vector stores
weaknesses: The licence is a modified Apache 2.0 that forbids operating a multi-tenant environment and forbids removing frontend branding, so it is source-available rather than open source
Its own documentation states the agent runtime is not intended as a hardened security boundary between mutually untrusted users
The hosted terms of service carry no version or last-updated date, so changes cannot be tracked
why_it_matters: A visual application builder that has grown an autonomous agent runtime, testing whether canvas tools and coding agents converge.
